notes: Discovery done: mapped existing trace endpoints and data needs; identified compare gaps; ready to design payload and API.

comments.author: honk
comments.text: Scope: identify data we need to diff two runs (run metadata, steps, artifacts), check existing /api/trace endpoints for pairwise fetch, note missing comparisons (duration deltas, status mismatches). Next: propose API shape for compare endpoint and captures list.

comments.author: honk
comments.text: Discovery findings: existing endpoints: /api/trace/runs (list), /api/trace/runs/<id>/trace (timeline JSON), /api/trace/runs/<id>/artifacts. Gap: no pairwise compare; we can fetch two runs client-side. Data we need per run: run_id, flow_name/version, started/ended, steps with status/label/duration, agent, raw, artifacts list. For diff we need: align steps by name/index; flag status mismatch; show duration delta; surface artifacts/logs per step. Proposal: add backend helper to fetch two traces and compute a compare payload (server-side) to reduce client work; fallback is client-only using existing endpoints. Next: design compare payload and decide server vs client.

comments.author: honk
comments.text: UX direction: side-by-side panels (Run A left, Run B right) with sticky header showing run ids, flow, started/ended, duration, label. Center column for diff summary: counts of matches/mismatches, duration delta, failing steps. Step list: paired rows aligned by step name; badges for status; duration delta pill; highlight mismatches. Artifacts/logs: per-step expandable drawer showing artifacts from each run with badges (new/missing/changed size). Actions: select run A/B via autocomplete (reusing traces list). Light/dark support and screenshot coverage via Playwright.
